prompt_text: I need braces or Invisalign in Kansas City. Which specific orthodontists should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Kansas City Missouri for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — I just need a couple quick details so I can give you the best specific suggestions:

1) Which part of Kansas City are you in (ZIP code or neighborhood)? KC is large and I’ll pick offices close to you.  
2) Is this for an adult or a child/teen? (Some doctors focus more on pediatric vs adult treatment.)  
3) Do you have dental/orthodontic insurance or a preference for lower-cost options?

If you want a quick answer now without giving location/insurance, I can also tell you how to find the best local orthodontists and give a shortlist of the exact questions to ask when you call. Which would you prefer?
